result.title: MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization
result.summary: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MultiAlloc，一个由轻量离线 profiling 驱动的 KV cache 量化框架，在固定显存预算下自适应地在「层级精度提升」与「token 级信息保留」两类策略之间分配量化资源，并直接落成推理期策略，无需在线搜索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按 token 重要性保留信息、并按层敏感度分配有限精度预算的思路，可能为 LVR 中「在显存/计算预算下保留关键视觉证据于内部状态」提供可核查的分配与筛选线索；但该工作仅面向纯文本 LLM 的长上下文推理，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态尚需核查。
